thread:
alex: Quick catch — during today's canary I saw a bunch of full fanouts despite tenant soft-backoff being active. noisy for the ops team.
sophia: saw it too. notify ended up suppressing but routing already blew up with parallel fanout calls. :crying_cat_face:
devon: current flow evaluates SLO trigger -> routing fans out -> notify applies quieting. that ordering leaves us paying for executor churn even when alerts are suppressed.
maria: that's not acceptable for dedicated customers. quota/backoff should reduce load, not just hide alerts.
alex: thinking of adding a routing prefilter that can coalesce fanouts when tenant.quota_state is soft_backoff. idea: short-circuit fanout for soft escalations into one low-priority delivery.
sophia: love the idea. console UX needs to reflect it though: alert preview should say "coalesced by routing prefilter" so SREs don't wonder where the fanouts went.
devon: proto sketch (pseudo):
```
message Prefilter {
  string type = 1; // tenant_backoff
  oneof behavior {
    bool enabled = 2;
    string mode = 3; // opt_in | opt_out
  }
  string action = 4; // coalesce | pass_through
}
```
we can gate by account flags.
maria: careful — some tenants run fast-detection canaries and explicitly want full fanout even during quota backoff. make it opt-in by default.
sophia: agreed. default off for enterprise-canaries. add a per-route override in the console.
devon: telemetry plan: add routing counters `fanout_attempts_pre_filter` and `fanout_coalesced_by_prefilter`. emit labels: tenant_id, route, escalation_level. then surface `fanout_coalescence_rate` in the SLO dashboard.
alex: can we also expose a heatmap for tenants with high coalescence rate so product can decide if this needs a permanent dashboard slot?
product: product ok to add a compact tile in the SLO reliability dashboard for coalescence metrics. we want an annotation to explain tradeoffs.
maria: i'll take the routing change (small Go patch). devon take telemetry + dashboards. sophia update notify docs and console alert preview. alex will open RFC/PR.
alertbot: Reminder: deploy window tomorrow 09:00 UTC. tag #release-war-room for deployment monitor.
sophia: i'll add a rollout checklist note: "enable prefilter per-tenant for canary; monitor fanout_coalescence_rate >= 0.8 -> rollback".
devon: will add dashboards and a query snippet in the PR. sample query: `sum(fanout_coalesced_by_prefilter) / sum(fanout_attempts_pre_filter) by (tenant_id)`
alex: timeline: aim for routing patch + counters by EOW, dashboards next week, small canary. thanks all, I'll file RFC now.
